newsitem.title: USA: IMC Global says CFO Brian Smith to resign.
newsitem.headline: IMC Global says CFO Brian Smith to resign.

text.p: Phospate and fertilizer maker IMC Global Inc said on Monday that Brian Smith is resigning as executive vice president and chief financial officer, effective on September 30.
Smith joined IMC Global in February 1996 after serving as chief financial officer and executive vice president of W.R. Grace & Co, the company said.
Smith agreed to advise IMC Global on a transitional basis, while the company searches for a successor.

"After much thought and consideration, Brian has chosen to pursue a lifestyle change that will enable him to spend more time traveling and managing his personal investments," IMC president and chief executive Robert Fowler Jr. said in a statement.
